headline: Dele Alli proves Spurs' good luck charm at Stamford Bridge again
description: Dele Alli was the hero during Tottenham's win at Chelsea in 2018 and he provided good luck for his old club on Saturday after he watched on at Stamford Bridge.

headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta collecting evidence on rival managers after yellow card
description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta said he has a "massive storage of images" showing rival Premier League managers breaking touchline rules after receiving his second yellow card of the season.

headline: Alonso: Chelsea need to have maturity to deal with difficult moments

headline: Chelsea's Xabi Alonso after Tottenham defeat: 'We lose together,' not fault of Mike Penders
description: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso refused to blame stand-in goalkeeper Mike Penders for his key error which helped Tottenham to a 2-0 win at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, and said Cole Palmer will learn from his red card.

headline: Make way for Arsenal, the people's Premier League champions
description: The sight of Man City pulling clear at the top of the Premier League table was not a good look for the biggest league in the world. But Arsenal's win against Everton showed they are ready to fight all the way this season.
